headline: Every pack of tortillas checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
visitLine: Call and visit to your outer-west site
heroLede: As your tortillas reach more stores, every pack needs the same check, whoever is on shift. Here's what a camera check could look like on your packing line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every bag is sealed straight across, with no creases and no tortilla caught in the seal. A bag that is not sealed properly dries out or spoils before its date.
labelLede: Packs of different sizes or products can look the same on a busy line. The camera checks every bag carries the right label for the product, straight and intact.
codeLede: Fresh tortillas have a short shelf life, so the best-before code has to be right and readable. The system reads the printed code on every bag and compares it with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Dough scraps, glove pieces and bag offcuts are all close at hand at packing. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a carton.

vocab.alert: Four creased seals in fifteen minutes on Line 1. Check the bag sealer.
